instruction: Set the swap compression level to maximum (9) in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the swap compression level to 9 (maximum) in GIMP preferences. The evaluator checks the gimprc configuration file for the swap-compression parameter with value 9. Uses existing check_config_status metric and gimp_config_file getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to set swap compression level to 9
Getter (gimp_config_file) correctly retrieves the gimprc configuration file where GIMP stores preferences
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses GIMP config format and checks for swap-compression key with value 9
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure settings are persisted to disk before verification
Expected value '9' matches the instruction requirement for maximum compression level
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified
Correct parameter handling: metric receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['key'] and rule['value'] without incorrect nested access
